mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.message_id, t.locale_id, t.text, l.id AS l_id, l.code AS l_code, l.name AS l_name, l.enabled AS l_enabled, l.sort_order AS l_sort_order, l.created_at AS l_created_at FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t JOIN pjt_i18n_locales l ON l.id = t.locale_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.message_id, t.locale_id, t.text, l.id AS l_id, l.code AS l_code, l.name AS l_name, l.enabled AS l_enabled, l.sort_order AS l_sort_order, l.created_at AS l_created_at FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t JOIN pjt_i18n_locales l ON l.id = t.locale_id WHERE t.message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.message_id, t.locale_id, t.text, l.id AS l_id, l.code AS l_code, l.name AS l_name, l.enabled AS l_enabled, l.sort_order AS l_sort_order, l.created_at AS l_created_at FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t JOIN pjt_i18n_locales l ON l.id = t.locale_id WHERE t.message_id = #{messageId} AND t.locale_id = #{localeId}

SELECT t.id, t.message_id, t.locale_id, t.text, m.id AS m_id, m.group_id AS m_group_id, m.code AS m_code, m.description AS m_description, m.created_at AS m_created_at, g.id AS g_id, g.code AS g_code, g.name AS g_name, g.description AS g_description, g.created_at AS g_created_at, l.id AS l_id, l.code AS l_code, l.name AS l_name, l.enabled AS l_enabled, l.sort_order AS l_sort_order, l.created_at AS l_created_at FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t JOIN pjt_i18n_messages m ON m.id = t.message_id JOIN pjt_i18n_message_groups g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN pjt_i18n_locales l ON l.id = t.locale_id WHERE l.code = #{localeCode}

SELECT t.id, t.message_id, t.locale_id, t.text, m.id AS m_id, m.group_id AS m_group_id, m.code AS m_code, m.description AS m_description, m.created_at AS m_created_at, g.id AS g_id, g.code AS g_code, g.name AS g_name, g.description AS g_description, g.created_at AS g_created_at, l.id AS l_id, l.code AS l_code, l.name AS l_name, l.enabled AS l_enabled, l.sort_order AS l_sort_order, l.created_at AS l_created_at FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t JOIN pjt_i18n_messages m ON m.id = t.message_id JOIN pjt_i18n_message_groups g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN pjt_i18n_locales l ON l.id = t.locale_id WHERE l.code = #{localeCode} AND g.code = #{groupCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pjt_i18n_message_texts (message_id, locale_id, text) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{localeId}, #{text})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pjt_i18n_message_texts t USING pjt_i18n_messages m WHERE t.message_id = m.id AND m.group_id = #{groupId}
